scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const v=pkg.devDependencies?.vite||pkg.overrides?.vite||''; const pr=pkg.devDependencies?.['@vitejs/plugin-react']||pkg.overrides?.['@vitejs/plugin-react']||''; if(!/^5\./.test(v)){console.error('ERROR: vite must be pinned to 5.x for Node 18'); process.exit(1);} if(!/^4\./.test(pr)){console.error('ERROR: @vitejs/plugin-react must be pinned to 4.x for Node 18'); process.exit(1);} if(fs.existsSync('package-lock.json')){try{const pl=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json','utf8')); const s=JSON.stringify(pl); if(/\"vite\"\s*:\s*\"7\./.test(s)){console.error('ERROR: Detected vite 7.x in package-lock.json which is incompatible with Node 18. Delete package-lock.json and run npm ci.'); process.exit(1);}}catch(e){}} if(fs.existsSync('npm-shrinkwrap.json')){try{const sw=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('npm-shrinkwrap.json','utf8')); const pkgs=sw.packages||{}; const root=pkgs['']||{}; const od=sw.overrides||{}; function bad(obj,key,req){const v=obj?.[key]; return !(typeof v==='string' && new RegExp('^'+req.replace('.', '\\.')+'\\.').test(v)); } if(!od['vite']){console.warn('WARNING: shrinkwrap missing overrides.vite; adding overrides is recommended.');} }catch(e){}} console.log('Verified Vite', v, 'and plugin-react', pr);"
scripts.dev: node -e "const v=require('vite/package.json').version; if(!/^5\./.test(v)){console.error('ERROR: vite', v, 'installed. Node 18 requires vite 5.x. Please reinstall deps.'); process.exit(1);}" && node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
